name: AskWell Phase 3.6 Synthetic Integration Corpus
description: Synthetic SaaS support articles and labeled questions for deterministic end-to-end retrieval, grounding, lifecycle, and failure evaluation.

documents.title: Account profile changes
documents.content: Customers can update their display name and company name from Account settings. Email address changes require confirming a link sent to the new address. If a user cannot access the old inbox, an owner must invite the new address and remove the old member after verification.

documents.title: Password recovery
documents.content: Use Forgot password on the sign in page to request a reset email. Reset links expire after sixty minutes and can be used once. If no email arrives, check spam, confirm the email belongs to an AskWell account, then request a new link.

documents.title: Workspace roles and permissions
documents.content: Owners can manage billing, delete the workspace, invite members, and change roles. Admins can manage articles, documents, widget settings, integrations, and inbox conversations. Agents can reply to conversations and view knowledge documents but cannot change billing or delete the workspace.

documents.title: Billing plans and limits
documents.content: Free workspaces include one owner, one widget, fifty conversations per month, and manual exports. Growth plans add five team seats, three widgets, Slack alerts, and five thousand conversations per month. Plan changes apply immediately and prorated credits appear on the next invoice.

documents.title: Free trial policy
documents.content: New workspaces receive a 14 day trial of Growth features. A payment card is not required during the trial. The trial includes Slack alerts, three widgets, and five team seats. When the trial ends, the workspace returns to the Free plan unless an owner selects a paid plan.

documents.title: Payment methods
documents.content: Owners can add or replace a payment card from Billing settings. AskWell accepts major credit and debit cards through the hosted billing portal. Bank transfer and purchase order billing are available only for enterprise contracts handled outside the self serve app.

documents.title: Refunds, cancellation, and downgrades
documents.content: Owners can cancel a paid plan from Billing settings. Cancellation stops renewal at the end of the current billing period. AskWell does not automatically refund partial months, but support can review duplicate charges within thirty days. Free workspaces keep their articles and conversation export.

documents.title: Invoices and tax details
documents.content: Invoices are available in Billing settings after each successful payment. Owners can update company name, billing email, tax ID, and address before the next invoice is issued. Past invoices keep the details that were active when the invoice was created.

documents.title: Widget installation
documents.content: Install the chat widget by copying the AskWell script from the Install tab and pasting it before the closing body tag on every page where support chat should appear. The widget loads from the AskWell site and connects back to the configured workspace. If the widget is missing, confirm the script is present, the workspace ID is correct, and no ad blocker is blocking the script.

documents.title: Widget branding settings
documents.content: Admins can change the widget brand name, accent color, welcome message, and launcher position from Widget settings. The preview updates immediately, but published websites may need a refresh before cached widget settings appear. Custom CSS is not supported in AskWell Lite.

documents.title: Slack alert integration
documents.content: Growth workspaces can connect Slack from Integrations settings. After authorization, choose one channel for new conversation alerts. AskWell posts a message when a customer starts a conversation or when an AI answer is marked unresolved. Disconnecting Slack stops new alerts but does not delete previous Slack messages.

documents.title: CRM webhook integration
documents.content: The CRM webhook sends conversation.created and conversation.resolved events to a customer endpoint. Webhooks use HTTPS POST with a JSON body and an AskWell signature header. Failed deliveries are retried three times with backoff. The endpoint must return a 2xx response within ten seconds.

documents.title: Conversation and knowledge export
documents.content: Owners and admins can export conversations as JSON from the Inbox page. Knowledge articles can be exported with the workspace export action. Exports include article titles, tags, conversation questions, answers, status, timestamps, and cited source IDs. Exports do not include payment card details or API keys.

documents.title: Conversation retention
documents.content: AskWell Lite keeps conversations in the workspace JSON store until an owner deletes or resets the workspace. Self hosted teams are responsible for their own backups and retention policy. The hosted roadmap will add configurable retention windows, but the Lite build does not automatically purge old conversations.

documents.title: Widget troubleshooting
documents.content: If the widget opens but does not answer, first check that the knowledge base has indexed documents. Then verify the Node backend can reach the FastAPI AI service. For local file demos, the browser falls back to keyword answers from localStorage because remote APIs are unavailable from file URLs.

documents.title: Email deliverability
documents.content: Password reset and invitation emails are sent from the AskWell transactional mailer. If delivery fails, ask the customer to check spam and allow the AskWell sending domain. Workspace owners can resend an invitation from Members settings. AskWell Lite does not include custom SMTP settings.

documents.title: Storage diagnostics and recovery
documents.content: The diagnostics panel checks storage readability, writability, SQLite integrity, vector dimensions, document counts, chunk counts, and embedding counts. Failed ingestion attempts are shown as documents needing attention when source content is still available. Retry reuses the original document ID and preserves the last valid indexed content if embedding or storage fails.

documents.title: API security controls
documents.content: Write APIs require the ASKWELL_ADMIN_TOKEN outside development mode. Static file serving uses an explicit allowlist and blocks private files such as data, package files, tests, server source, and environment files. The Node backend also applies rate limiting, JSON body validation, security headers, and a restrictive content security policy.
